unit.why: A memorate told by the Mogielnica rebbe: in Lublin the Seer's sons repeatedly brought him, carelessly dressed, before their father, who exempted him from his rule on proper dress and loved him exceptionally.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מפיו הק׳ הרבה פעמים, ואמר
stories.end_quote: יהא הרבי ז"ל מלובלין אוהב אותו כמו שאהב אותי
stories.summary_en: The Rabbi of Mogielnica recalled that the Seer of Lublin insisted hasidim dress decently, yet when the Seer's sons brought the carelessly dressed young man before him, the Seer replied in Yiddish 'I don't mean him', and he loved him more than almost anyone.

ורק לילך לבוש נאה כדרך העולם
שלא להשגיח עלי האיך אני לבוש
